faq.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faq.answer: Yes! Walk-ins are welcome. On busy weekends, arriving early is your best bet. For large groups (8+), call ahead at (415) 360-3666 so we can ready a table.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Yes, free parking is available in the large Buena Park Downtown lot.

faq.question: Can I celebrate a birthday here?
faq.answer: Absolutely — we love birthdays. For celebrations with more than 8 guests, we offer birthday packages. Call us at (415) 360-3666 or email info@domokuncafe.com and we’ll set you up.

faq.question: Do you deliver?
faq.answer: Yes — order online for pickup or delivery through Toast. You can also visit us in Buena Park or call (415) 360-3666.

faq.question: Where can I follow updates?
faq.answer: Follow us on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook for announcements and seasonal news.
